summary: AviCalc frontend-only verification of (a) decimal input sanitization and (b) torque half-up rounding. All 6 torque assertions and the fuel regression passed on viewport 390x844 using press_sequentially so onChangeText sanitization triggers.
test_report_links: Playwright executed via mcp_browser_automation against https://flight-ops-calc.preview.emergentagent.com/torque and /
critical_code_review_comments: sanitizeDecimal in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx correctly preserves the first separator (either '.' or ',') and strips the rest; parseNum normalizes commas to dots before parseFloat.
fmt in ui.tsx uses toPrecision(12) to strip float noise before Math.round, giving true half-up (8.85->8.9, 1 Nm->8.85 inlb->rounds to 9).
torque.tsx DECIMALS map correctly set to {nm:1, inlb:0, ftlb:1}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Torque screen testIDs: torque-input, torque-from-unit-{nm|inlb|ftlb}, torque-result-{nm|inlb|ftlb}, torque-clear-button. Fuel testIDs: fuel-requested-input, fuel-shutdown-input, fuel-uplift-volume, fuel-clear-button. IMPORTANT: use locator.press_sequentially (not fill) for sanitization tests so onChangeText fires per keystroke. Viewport 390x844.
rca_of_issue: N/A - verification iteration, no bugs reproduced.
